policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="mcpMethod" value="@{
      if (context.Request.Method != "POST") { return context.Request.Method.ToLower(); }
      var body = context.Request.Body?.As(preserveContent: true);
      var m = body == null ? null : (string)body["method"];
      return string.IsNullOrEmpty(m) ? "unknown" : m;
    }" />

    
    
      
        {{mcp-client-id}}
        api://{{mcp-client-id}}
      
    

    
    
    
    
    
    
    

    
    
    
    
    
    
      
        
          
          
            @((60 - DateTime.UtcNow.Second).ToString())
          
          
            application/json
          
          @(new JObject(
            new JProperty("error", "rate_limited"),
            new JProperty("decidedBy", "gateway"),
            new JProperty("pep", "gateway"),
            new JProperty("reason", "More than {{rate-limit-per-minute}} MCP requests in this minute for caller " + (string)context.Variables["azp"]),
            new JProperty("mcpMethod", (string)context.Variables["mcpMethod"])).ToString())
        
      
    

    
    
    
    
    
      
        
          @("{{killswitch-url}}/kills/check?agent=" + (string)context.Variables["azp"] + "&blueprint=" + (string)context.Variables["blueprint"] + "&user=" + (string)context.Variables["oid"])
          GET
          
            {{internal-key}}
          
        
        <set-variable name="killCheck" value="@{
          var r = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("killResp");
          if (r == null || r.StatusCode != 200) { return "unavailable"; }
          return r.Body.As();
        }" />
        
          
            
          
        
      
    
    
      
        
          
          
            application/json
          
          @(new JObject(
            new JProperty("error", "kill_list_unavailable"),
            new JProperty("decidedBy", "gateway"),
            new JProperty("pep", "gateway"),
            new JProperty("reason", "The kill list could not be read; agents fail closed."),
            new JProperty("mcpMethod", (string)context.Variables["mcpMethod"])).ToString())
        
      
      
        
          
          
            application/json
          
          @(new JObject(
            new JProperty("error", "agent_disabled"),
            new JProperty("decidedBy", "gateway"),
            new JProperty("pep", "gateway"),
            new JProperty("reason", "This caller is on the kill list."),
            new JProperty("killList", new JObject(
              new JProperty("checked", true),
              new JProperty("hit", true),
              new JProperty("cached", (bool)context.Variables["killCached"]),
              new JProperty("entries", JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["killCheck"])["entries"]))),
            new JProperty("mcpMethod", (string)context.Variables["mcpMethod"])).ToString())
        
      
    

    
    
      {{pdp-url}}/access/v1/evaluation
      POST
      
        application/json
      
      
        {{internal-key}}
      
      
        @(context.RequestId.ToString())
      
      @{
        var perms = new JArray(((string)context.Variables["permissions"]).Split(' ').Where(p => p.Length > 0).ToArray());
        var ctx = new JObject(
          new JProperty("pep", "gateway"),
          new JProperty("mcpMethod", (string)context.Variables["mcpMethod"]),
          new JProperty("time", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("o")));
        if ((string)context.Variables["oid"] != "") {
          ctx.Add("onBehalfOf", (string)context.Variables["oid"]);
          ctx.Add("onBehalfOfUpn", (string)context.Variables["upn"]);
        }
        var props = new JObject(new JProperty("permissions", perms));
        if ((string)context.Variables["blueprint"] != "") { props.Add("blueprint", (string)context.Variables["blueprint"]); }
        return new JObject(
          new JProperty("subject", new JObject(
            new JProperty("type", (string)context.Variables["subjectType"]),
            new JProperty("id", (string)context.Variables["azp"]),
            new JProperty("properties", props))),
          new JProperty("action", new JObject(new JProperty("name", "mcp:" + (string)context.Variables["mcpMethod"]))),
          new JProperty("resource", new JObject(new JProperty("type", "mcp_server"), new JProperty("id", "claims-mcp"))),
          new JProperty("context", ctx)).ToString();
      }
    
    
      <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("pdpResp") == null || ((IResponse)context.Variables["pdpResp"]).StatusCode != 200)">
        
          
          
            application/json
          
          @(new JObject(
            new JProperty("error", "pdp_unavailable"),
            new JProperty("decidedBy", "gateway"),
            new JProperty("pep", "gateway"),
            new JProperty("reason", "The policy decision point could not be reached; failing closed."),
            new JProperty("mcpMethod", (string)context.Variables["mcpMethod"])).ToString())
        
      
    
    <set-variable name="pdpResult" value="@(((IResponse)context.Variables["pdpResp"]).Body.As())" />
    
      
        
          
          
            application/json
          
          @{
            var pdp = (JObject)context.Variables["pdpResult"];
            var c = (JObject)pdp["context"];
            return new JObject(
              new JProperty("error", "forbidden"),
              new JProperty("decidedBy", "gateway"),
              new JProperty("pep", "gateway"),
              new JProperty("reason", (string)c.SelectToken("reason_user.en")),
              new JProperty("authzen", new JObject(
                new JProperty("decision", false),
                new JProperty("policyIds", c["policyIds"]),
                new JProperty("policyVersion", c["policyVersion"]),
                new JProperty("reason_admin", (string)c.SelectToken("reason_admin.en")),
                new JProperty("user", c["user"]))),
              new JProperty("killList", c["killList"]),
              new JProperty("mcpMethod", (string)context.Variables["mcpMethod"])).ToString();
          }
        
      
    

    
    
      {{gateway-key}}
    
    
      @{
        var c = (JObject)((JObject)context.Variables["pdpResult"])["context"];
        var summary = new JObject(
          new JProperty("decision", true),
          new JProperty("mcpMethod", (string)context.Variables["mcpMethod"]),
          new JProperty("policyIds", c["policyIds"]),
          new JProperty("policyVersion", c["policyVersion"]),
          new JProperty("killList", new JObject(
            new JProperty("checked", true),
            new JProperty("hit", false),
            new JProperty("cached", (bool)context.Variables["killCached"]))),
          new JProperty("rateLimit", new JObject(
            new JProperty("count", (int)context.Variables["rlNext"]),
            new JProperty("limitPerMinute", {{rate-limit-per-minute}}))),
          new JProperty("gatewayRequestId", context.RequestId.ToString()));
        return Convert.ToBase64String(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(summary.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None)));
      }

return-response.set-body: @(new JObject( new JProperty("error", "invalid_token"), new JProperty("decidedBy", "gateway"), new JProperty("pep", "gateway"), new JProperty("reason", context.LastError.Message)).ToString())
